description: Read observed role aggregates by standard job family (function), country or seniority across covered employers in the last 1–26 calendar weeks of the index snapshot. Returns the top values per week by open roles (top, 1–200; values_omitted says how many were cut) or one exact value. Counts are affected by changing coverage and partial inventories; unknown seniority includes compacted evidence.
name: get_market_trends
